technology_stack.training_data: Billions of text and image examples

prompt.description: Natural language image description. No special syntax, flags, or markup.
prompt.notes: Detailed prompts outperform short ones. Cover subject, style, environment, lighting, mood, and technical details.

n.description: Number of images to generate per request. UI generates 4 by default.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. See aspect_ratios table.

response_format.description: How the image is returned. URLs are temporary — download promptly.

image_url.description: Single source image URL or base64 data URI for editing. Output aspect ratio follows input.

image_urls.description: Up to 3 source images for multi-image editing. Output follows first image's aspect ratio unless overridden.

aspect_ratio.description: Override output aspect ratio (default follows input image)

square.use_case: Social media posts, thumbnails, profile images

widescreen.use_case: Widescreen landscapes, desktop wallpapers (16:9); mobile stories, TikTok (9:16)

auto.use_case: Model auto-selects best ratio for the prompt content

prompt_limits.hard_limit: No published character limit for image generation text prompts
prompt_limits.best_practice: Detailed prompts outperform short ones; Aurora handles longer descriptions well

seed_parameter.purpose: Seed number for visual reproducibility (NOT style — changed from Flux era)
seed_parameter.usage: Same seed + same prompt = visually consistent results
seed_parameter.critical_note: In FLUX.1 era, --s was a style reference. In Aurora, it is a seed. Update existing workflows.

negative_guidance.syntax: Inline 'avoid:' list at end of prompt
negative_guidance.example: avoid: cartoon, anime, illustration, distorted features, extra fingers
negative_guidance.notes: No separate negative_prompt parameter. Include within main prompt text.

conversational_refinement.description: Within a single Grok chat session, model retains previous prompt context
examples: Regenerate that but with darker lighting
Keep everything but change the background to a forest
Same composition but in oil painting style
conversational_refinement.notes: Only works within the same chat session. New sessions have no memory.

resolution_and_output.output_format: JPEG (URL); PNG and WebP available via third-party hosts
resolution_and_output.url_expiration: Generated URLs are temporary — download images promptly
resolution_and_output.ui_batch_size: 4 variations per prompt in Grok UI
resolution_and_output.api_batch_size: 1-10 images per request via n parameter

video_generation.notes: This SKILL focuses on image generation. Video generation covered in separate SKILL.

api.notes: No subscription required for API access

rate_limits.context_window: Total text + image tokens must fit within model context
rate_limits.api_rate: Subject to xAI rate limit policies

photorealistic_portrait.prompt_emphasis: Camera model, lens, aperture, lighting setup, skin texture

cinematic_concept_art.prompt_emphasis: Lean into Aurora's cinematic default. Add composition and mood.

product_photography.prompt_emphasis: Studio lighting specs, surface materials, brand-style references

social_media_content.prompt_emphasis: Quick, punchy prompts. Specify platform aesthetic.

character_consistency_series.prompt_emphasis: Copy-paste identical character description. Change only scene/action.

editorial_illustration.prompt_emphasis: EXPLICITLY override cinematic default with target style name

image_editing_refinement.prompt_emphasis: Describe changes relative to source image. Be specific about what to keep vs change.

cinematic_bias.problem: All output looks like Hollywood movie stills regardless of prompt intent
cinematic_bias.cause: Aurora's default aesthetic is cinematic blockbuster
cinematic_bias.solution: Explicitly name alternative style: 'documentary photography, natural light only,' or 'minimalist illustration, flat colors'

hand_finger_distortion.problem: Hands have wrong number of fingers or unnatural poses
hand_finger_distortion.solution: Add 'anatomically correct hands' to prompt, or frame the shot to hide hands

url_expiration.problem: Generated image URLs stop working after some time

contradictory_instructions.problem: Output is confused, trying to satisfy two competing directives
contradictory_instructions.cause: Prompt contains contradictory style or subject instructions
contradictory_instructions.solution: Choose one coherent direction per prompt. Split contradictions into separate generations.

seed_confusion.cause: --s parameter changed meaning from style (Flux) to seed (Aurora)
seed_confusion.solution: Use --s for reproducibility/consistency. Describe style in prompt text.

flat_default_lighting.problem: Image has generic, flat lighting despite detailed prompt
flat_default_lighting.cause: No lighting direction specified in prompt
flat_default_lighting.solution: Add specific lighting: 'Rembrandt lighting from upper left,' 'backlit rim light,' 'volumetric fog'

aurora_vs_flux_migration.seed_parameter: In Flux: --s = style reference. In Aurora: --s = seed number for reproducibility.
aurora_vs_flux_migration.default_aesthetic: Aurora defaults to cinematic. Flux was more neutral. Add explicit style direction.
aurora_vs_flux_migration.batch_output: Aurora UI generates 4 images per prompt vs Flux's 1. Adjust selection workflow.
aurora_vs_flux_migration.negative_prompts: Use inline 'avoid:' phrasing. Video generation ignores negative prompts entirely.
aurora_vs_flux_migration.general_tip: Existing Flux prompts work but may look more cinematic than expected.
